命名：起点小说官方
✅ 搜索支持：支持搜索书名/作者，集成 WAF 智能自动过盾重试
✅ 详情完备：提取高清大封面、作者白金/大神称号、字数、月票/推票/盟主荣誉及完整简介
✅ 目录解析：层级分明，准确保留卷标题（正文、VIP卷、作品相关），自动标记 VIP 锁定章节
✅ 正文提取：精准提取 main 容器正文段落，排版自动清洗；VIP 章节支持官方试读与订阅提示
✅ 丰富发现：集成起点月票榜、畅销榜、阅读指数榜及 14 大作品分类库

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
var bookId = baseUrl.match(/\d+/)[0];

// 0. 自动注入基础统计 Cookie 防止被安全系统拦截
try {
    var cCookie = java.getCookie('https://qidian.com', 'newstatisticUUID');
    if (!cCookie) {
        var nId = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000);
        Packages.io.legado.app.help.http.CookieStore.INSTANCE.setCookie('https://qidian.com', 'newstatisticUUID=' + nId + '; domain=.qidian.com; path=/');
    }
} catch(e) {}

// 1. 移动端 PageData
var mDoc = null;
var pageData = null;
try {
    var mRes = java.ajax('https://m.qidian.com/book/' + bookId + '/');
    mDoc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(mRes);
    var scripts = mDoc.select('script');
    for (var i = 0; i < scripts.size(); i++) {
        var txt = scripts.get(i).html();
        if (txt.indexOf('pageProps') > -1) {
            var j = JSON.parse(txt);
            var pp = (j.props && j.props.pageProps) || (j.pageContext && j.pageContext.pageProps) || j;
            pageData = pp.pageData || (pp.pageContext && pp.pageContext.pageData) || pp;
            break;
        }
    }
} catch(e) {}

var pd = pageData || {};
var bi = pd.bookInfo || {};
var be = pd.bookExtra || {};
var ai = pd.authorInfo || {};
var mti = pd.monthTicketInfo || {};
var rti = pd.recTicketInfo || {};
var fi = pd.fansInfo || {};
var stamps = pd.stamps || [];

// 2. 官方作者主页原生解析 (优先读取 cid/authorId)
var authorId = bi.authorId || ai.authorId || bi.cAuthorId || ai.cAuthorId;
var authorDetail = null;
var authorInfo = null;
var authorBooks = [];

if (authorId) {
    try {
        var aRes = java.ajax('https://m.qidian.com/author/' + authorId + '/');
        var aDoc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(aRes);
        var aScripts = aDoc.select('script');
        for (var i = 0; i < aScripts.size(); i++) {
            var sText = aScripts.get(i).html();
            if (sText.indexOf('pageContext') > -1 || sText.indexOf('pageProps') > -1) {
                var aJson = JSON.parse(sText);
                var pp = (aJson.props && aJson.props.pageProps) || (aJson.pageContext && aJson.pageContext.pageProps) || aJson;
                var aData = pp.pageData || pp;
                if (aData) {
                    authorDetail = aData.authorDetail;
                    authorInfo = aData.info;
                    if (aData.allBook) authorBooks = aData.allBook;
                    else if (authorDetail && authorDetail.bookList) authorBooks = authorDetail.bookList;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch(e) {}
}

var nl = String.fromCharCode(10);
var sections = [];

// ① 作品简介 (读者阅读第一关切：故事核心梗概)
var desc = bi.desc || '';
if (!desc && mDoc) desc = mDoc.select('[property$=description]').attr('content');
if (desc) {
    var cleanDesc = desc.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, nl).replace(/ /gi, ' ').trim();
    sections.push('📜 简介：' + nl + cleanDesc);
}

// ② 题材人设：官方标签与主要角色
var settingLines = [];
var tagList = [];
if (be.ugcTagInfos && be.ugcTagInfos.length > 0) {
    for (var i = 0; i < be.ugcTagInfos.length; i++) {
        var t = be.ugcTagInfos[i].tagName;
        if (t && tagList.indexOf(t) === -1) tagList.push(t);
    }
}
if (tagList.length > 0) {
    settingLines.push('🏷 标签：' + tagList.slice(0, 6).join(' · '));
}

var roleList = be.roleList || pd.roles || [];
if (roleList.length > 0) {
    var rStrs = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < Math.min(roleList.length, 5); i++) {
        var r = roleList[i];
        rStrs.push(r.roleName + (r.position ? ('（' + r.position + '）') : ''));
    }
    settingLines.push('🎭 角色：' + rStrs.join('、'));
}
if (settingLines.length > 0) {
    sections.push(settingLines.join(nl));
}

// ③ 品质背书：殿堂荣誉、徽章与里程碑 (荣誉无括号纯净展示)
var honorLines = [];
var badgeList = [];
for (var i = 0; i < stamps.length; i++) {
    var bName = stamps[i].badgeName || (stamps[i].badge && stamps[i].badge.badgeName) || '';
    if (bName && badgeList.indexOf(bName) === -1) {
        badgeList.push(bName);
    }
}

var starHonor = '';
var starLevels = ['荣耀五星', '荣耀四星', '荣耀三星', '荣耀二星', '荣耀一星'];
for (var i = 0; i < starLevels.length; i++) {
    if (badgeList.indexOf(starLevels[i]) > -1) {
        starHonor = starLevels[i];
        break;
    }
}

var honorTitle = '';
if (starHonor) {
    honorTitle = starHonor + '作品';
} else if (badgeList.indexOf('十万均订') > -1) {
    honorTitle = '十万均订作品';
} else if (badgeList.indexOf('千盟逐鹿') > -1) {
    honorTitle = '千盟逐鹿作品';
} else if (badgeList.indexOf('精品频道') > -1) {
    honorTitle = '精品频道作品';
} else if (badgeList.indexOf('万人追捧') > -1) {
    honorTitle = '万人追捧作品';
}

if (honorTitle) {
    honorLines.push('🏆 荣誉：' + honorTitle + (badgeList.length > 0 ? (' ｜ 共获得 ' + badgeList.length + ' 枚徽章') : ''));
} else if (badgeList.length > 0) {
    honorLines.push('🏆 荣誉：共获得 ' + badgeList.length + ' 枚作品徽章');
}

if (badgeList.length > 0) {
    honorLines.push('🎖️ 徽章：' + badgeList.slice(0, 10).join(' · '));
}

// 碑记 (精选高光战绩，净化括号内容)
var mList = [];
var rawHonors = pd.bookHonorList || pd.honors || [];
function mScore(desc) {
    if (!desc) return 0;
    if (desc.indexOf('第一名') > -1) return 10;
    if (desc.indexOf('第二名') > -1 || desc.indexOf('第三名') > -1) return 9;
    if (desc.indexOf('收藏') > -1) return 8;
    if (desc.indexOf('大封推') > -1) return 7;
    if (desc.indexOf('编辑封推') > -1 || desc.indexOf('中封推') > -1) return 6;
    if (desc.indexOf('十强') > -1 || desc.indexOf('前十') > -1) return 5;
    if (desc.indexOf('第') > -1 && desc.indexOf('名') > -1) return 4;
    return 1;
}

var sortedHonors = [];
for (var i = 0; i < rawHonors.length; i++) {
    sortedHonors.push(rawHonors[i]);
}
sortedHonors.sort(function(a, b) {
    var descA = a.honorDesc || a.desc || '';
    var descB = b.honorDesc || b.desc || '';
    return mScore(descB) - mScore(descA);
});

for (var i = 0; i < sortedHonors.length; i++) {
    var descH = sortedHonors[i].honorDesc || sortedHonors[i].desc || '';
    if (descH && mList.indexOf(descH) === -1) {
        var cleanH = descH.replace(/\((.*?)\)/g, ' $1 ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        mList.push(cleanH);
        if (mList.length >= 2) break;
    }
}
if (mList.length > 0) {
    honorLines.push('🚩 碑记：' + mList.join(' ｜ '));
}
if (honorLines.length > 0) {
    sections.push(honorLines.join(nl));
}

// ④ 实时热度与历程：月票、推荐、圈子、时间
var dataLines = [];
var mTicket = mti.monthCnt || bi.monthTicket || '';
var rRank = mti.rank ? (' ｜ 月票榜 No.' + mti.rank) : '';
if (mTicket) {
    dataLines.push('💰 月票：' + mTicket + ' 票' + rRank);
}

var tRec = be.rcmTicketCount ? (Number(be.rcmTicketCount) >= 10000 ? (Number(be.rcmTicketCount)/10000).toFixed(2) + '万' : be.rcmTicketCount) : (bi.recomAll ? (Number(bi.recomAll)/10000).toFixed(2) + '万' : '');
var wRec = rti.weekCnt || bi.recomWeek || '';
if (tRec || wRec) {
    var recParts = [];
    if (tRec) recParts.push('总推 ' + tRec);
    if (wRec) recParts.push('周推 ' + wRec + ' 票');
    dataLines.push('🌟 推荐：' + recParts.join(' ｜ '));
}

var fansStr = fi.fansTotal || (be.fansCount ? (Number(be.fansCount) >= 10000 ? (Number(be.fansCount)/10000).toFixed(2) + '万' : be.fansCount) : '');
var circleLevel = (ai.level || ai.authorLevel) ? ('Lv.' + (ai.level || ai.authorLevel) + ' 出圈指数') : '';
var postStr = (be.bookCirclePostCount || pd.bookCirclePostCount) ? ('讨论帖 ' + (Number(be.bookCirclePostCount || pd.bookCirclePostCount) >= 10000 ? (Number(be.bookCirclePostCount || pd.bookCirclePostCount)/10000).toFixed(1) + '万条' : (be.bookCirclePostCount || pd.bookCirclePostCount) + '条')) : '';
var circleParts = [];
if (fansStr) circleParts.push(fansStr + ' 书友');
if (circleLevel) circleParts.push(circleLevel);
if (postStr) circleParts.push(postStr);
if (circleParts.length > 0) {
    dataLines.push('👥 圈子：' + circleParts.join(' ｜ '));
}

var tUp = bi.updTime || '';
var fTime = '';
if (bi.joinTime) {
    var dObj = new Date(bi.joinTime * 1000);
    fTime = dObj.getFullYear() + '-' + ('0' + (dObj.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + dObj.getDate()).slice(-2);
}
var timeParts = [];
if (fTime) timeParts.push(fTime + ' 开坑');
if (tUp) timeParts.push(tUp + (bi.bookStatus === '完本' ? ' 完结' : ' 更新'));
if (timeParts.length > 0) {
    dataLines.push('🌱 历程：' + timeParts.join(' ｜ '));
}
if (dataLines.length > 0) {
    sections.push(dataLines.join(nl));
}

// ⑤ 作家档案与代表作 (整合 authorInfo 与 authorDetail)
var aLevel = '';
var aDesc = '';
var aStats = [];
var otherWorks = [];

if (authorInfo && authorInfo.rank) {
    var r = String(authorInfo.rank).trim();
    aLevel = r.endsWith('作家') ? r : (r + '作家');
} else if (authorDetail && authorDetail.level) {
    var lvl = String(authorDetail.level).trim();
    lvl = lvl.replace(/^Lv(\d+)$/i, 'Lv.$1');
    aLevel = lvl.endsWith('作家') ? lvl : (lvl + '作家');
} else if (authorInfo && authorInfo.level) {
    aLevel = 'Lv.' + authorInfo.level + '作家';
}

if (authorInfo && authorInfo.desc) {
    aDesc = String(authorInfo.desc).trim();
} else if (authorDetail && authorDetail.desc) {
    aDesc = String(authorDetail.desc).trim();
}

if (authorInfo) {
    if (authorInfo.cnt) aStats.push('累计创作 ' + (String(authorInfo.cnt).indexOf('万') > -1 ? authorInfo.cnt : Math.round(Number(authorInfo.cnt)/10000) + '万字'));
    if (authorInfo.days) aStats.push(authorInfo.days + '天历程');
} else if (authorDetail) {
    if (authorDetail.words) aStats.push('累计创作 ' + Math.round(Number(authorDetail.words) / 10000) + '万字');
    if (authorDetail.days) aStats.push(authorDetail.days + '天历程');
    if (authorDetail.fans) aStats.push((Number(authorDetail.fans) >= 10000 ? Math.round(Number(authorDetail.fans) / 10000) + '万' : authorDetail.fans) + '粉丝');
}

if (authorBooks && authorBooks.length > 0) {
    for (var i = 0; i < authorBooks.length && otherWorks.length < 3; i++) {
        var b = authorBooks[i];
        var bName = b.bName || b.bookName;
        var bId = String(b.bid || b.bookId || '');
        if (bId === String(bookId) || bName === bi.bookName) continue;
        
        var wStr = b.wordStrAllCnt || (b.wordsCnt ? (Number(b.wordsCnt) >= 10000 ? (Number(b.wordsCnt)/10000).toFixed(1) + '万字' : b.wordsCnt + '字') : '');
        var sStr = b.bookStatus || (b.isFinish === 1 ? '完本' : '连载');
        sStr = sStr.replace('已经', '').replace('中', '');
        otherWorks.push('• 《' + bName + '》' + (wStr ? ('（' + wStr + (sStr ? ('·' + sStr) : '') + '）') : ''));
    }
}

if (!aLevel) {
    aLevel = (ai.authorLevel >= 1 && ai.authorLevel <= 5) ? ('Lv.' + ai.authorLevel + '作家') : '作家';
}

var aStatsStr = aStats.length > 0 ? ('（' + aStats.join(' · ') + '）') : '';
sections.push('👤 作者：' + aLevel + ' · ' + (bi.authorName || ai.authorName || '起点作家') + aStatsStr + (aDesc ? (nl + aDesc) : ''));

if (otherWorks.length > 0) {
    sections.push('📖 代表作品：' + nl + otherWorks.join(nl));
}

sections.join(nl + nl);
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var json;
var resStr = String(result || '').trim();
if (typeof result === 'object' && result && result.data && result.data.vs) {
    json = result;
} else if (resStr.startsWith('{')) {
    json = JSON.parse(resStr);
} else {
    var csrf = cookie.getKey('https://qidian.com', '_csrfToken') || java.getCookie('https://qidian.com', '_csrfToken');
    var bookId = baseUrl.match(/\d+/)[0];
    var apiUrl = 'https://m.qidian.com/majax/book/category?bookId=' + bookId + '&_csrfToken=' + csrf;
    json = JSON.parse(java.ajax(apiUrl));
}
var vs = json.data.vs;
var bookId = json.data.bookId || baseUrl.match(/\d+/)[0];
var list = [];
for (var i = 0; i < vs.length; i++) {
    var v = vs[i];
    var isPaid = v.vS === 1;
    if (!isPaid && v.cs && v.cs.length > 0) {
        for (var k = 0; k < v.cs.length; k++) {
            if (v.cs[k].sS === 0) {
                isPaid = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    var tag = isPaid ? '付费' : '免费';
    var vName = String(v.vN).trim();
    if (v.cCnt) {
        vName += ' · 共' + v.cCnt + '章 · ' + tag;
    } else {
        vName += ' · ' + tag;
    }
    list.push({
        name: vName,
        isVolume: true
    });
    for (var j = 0; j < v.cs.length; j++) {
        var c = v.cs[j];
        list.push({
            name: String(c.cN).trim(),
            url: 'https://m.qidian.com/chapter/' + bookId + '/' + c.id + '/',
            isVip: c.sS === 0,
            update: c.uT,
            isVolume: false
        });
    }
}
list;
